name: Sakurai Yui
source:
She is a childhood sweetheart of Yuta and a descendant of the same school. In school, she is a super popular and beautiful girl with excellent character and education, always with a gentle and lovely appearance. Yui has many pursuers in school, but she chooses to stay by Yuta's side and exchange hobbies about "Okatu" with him.

Her hobby is cooking.
